clips.title: The story
paras: Blackfathom Deeps is where the Twilight's Hammer has made its lair, and Baron Aquanis rises from its flooded Moonshrine Ruins. He appears when someone disturbs the Fathom Stone, while the Earthen Ring suspects the cult has corrupted him.

The Fathom Stone lies beneath the flooded halls of the Moonshrine Ruins, right under the noses of the Twilight's Hammer cultists who occupy them. Within the stone rests a fathom core, a device that reveals the history of nearby elemental activity when properly read. Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring sends Horde adventurers to recover it. Disturbing the stone draws Baron Aquanis up from the depths.
